# KMS

Exercise local cryptographic key and alias workflows.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `kms` |
| Signing name | `kms` |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#kms) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Grants and grant tokens are stored but do not authorize access; grant constraints are not evaluated.
- No key-material rotation, imports, custom key stores or multi-region keys.
- No KEY_AGREEMENT, secp256k1, SM2, ML-DSA or attestation recipient behavior.
- Local ciphertext formats are emulator-specific.
- Service-specific KMS condition keys and AWS owner-only cross-account API restrictions are not modeled; in-process service calls bypass gateway policy enforcement.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
